{{Quote|That makes sixteen, gamblers. Sixteen is the number. Payoff is now five-to-one.|G0-16|<ref name="SL" />}}
'''G0-16''' was a [[fan-tan]] [[Dealer droid/Legends|dealer droid]] that worked at the [[Fifteen Moons Casino/Legends|Fifteen Moons Casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. The droid lacked sympathy for the players, and would routinely skip over players who didn't meet its eye during gameplay.

G0-16 once tried to ignore [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] bid during a game, shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. At the time, Solo was being distracted by a small [[Droid/Legends|droid]] dispatched by [[Alfreda Goot]]. Solo subsequently argued with the droid, causing a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[pit-boss]] to intervene and allow Solo to place his bid.
